about:
JE Import Performance operates from a 60,000-square-foot facility in Baltimore, Maryland. The company was founded in 1998 with a mission to serve the performance needs of local car enthusiasts while providing dependable, honest automotive service. Over nearly three decades, that mission has grown into a full-service automotive center.

The shop delivers complete automotive care under one roof, covering maintenance, repair, and performance upgrades for import, domestic, and European vehicles. Services include brake system repair, climate control repair, engine diagnostics and repair, muffler and exhaust work, oil and filter changes, transmission and drivetrain service, timing belt and chain service, tire repair and installation, and wheel alignment. The facility also handles performance tuning and custom builds, drawing on racing-proven experience.

The customer base consists of Baltimore-area drivers and car enthusiasts who own import, domestic, or European vehicles, ranging from daily commuters to those pursuing ambitious performance builds.

The company emphasizes practical expertise and attention to detail, rooted in racing experience that translates directly into its performance service offerings.
